Lockheed Martin develops purposeful innovations that help keep people safe and address complex challenges. The Associate Member Engineering Staff will design, develop, integrate, and test software for target modeling and simulation systems supporting Department of Defense products and technologies, while addressing defects and optimizing system performance.

Responsibilities
You will participate in design, development, integration, and testing of new capabilities for several Department of Defense (DoD) products and technologies
You will use and contribute to models of real-world weapons, radars, Command & Control systems
You will independently identify and address system and software defects, demonstrate an ability to practice sound systems and software engineering discipline, and decompose complex problems to formulate solutions
In this role, you will design, modify, develop and integrate software for target modeling and simulation systems using agile methods
You will perform code reviews, optimize algorithms, and conduct experiments to ensure the functionality and performance of the developed products meets the requirements
